title: Day 775: One Killed, Three Wounded in Separate Shootings Across Tierra Blanca, Felipe Ángeles and Bosques del Álamo
detail: A wave of separate gun attacks hit at least three Culiacán neighborhoods on Sunday, September 6, 2026. In the Tierra Blanca sector, Juan Carlos 'N' (reported as 40–44 years old) was shot multiple times by occupants of a motorcycle while driving through the neighborhood and died of his wounds. In the Felipe Ángeles colonia, a man of about 30 was shot on Calle Manuel Gutiérrez and taken to hospital with injuries. In Bosques del Álamo, two more men were wounded in a separate motorcycle-borne shooting. Sinaloa authorities also reported a vehicle pursuit that ended with three civilians detained at a motel following a chase along Calzada Heroico Colegio Militar. State prosecutors said the day's violence left six people dead statewide and opened investigations into each attack; no arrests tied to the fatal Tierra Blanca shooting had been announced.

title: Day 775: Hooded Men Attempt to Abduct Search-Collective Mother Yodeli Benítez in Front of Her Children
detail: Around 3:00 PM on Sunday, September 6, 2026, hooded men attempted to forcibly abduct Yodeli Benítez — a member of the search collective '¿Dónde Están?' who has searched for her son Paúl Jacobo Benítez since his March 30, 2025 disappearance — near her home in Culiacán while her two minor children were present. Benítez resisted and the attackers fled without identifying themselves; she said she received threats the same day and, fearing reprisal, opted not to file a formal report with the state Prosecutor's Office. It was the second attack on a search-collective member in Culiacán in two weeks, following the August 29 shooting of 'Voces Unidas por la Vida' founder Alma Rosa Rojo Medina. The collective Sabuesos Guerreras demanded an immediate investigation with a human-rights perspective and protective measures under the federal Mechanism for the Protection of Human Rights Defenders, and renewed a request — unanswered after three attempts — for a meeting with interim Governor Graciela Domínguez Nava.
